stages.name: clean-cloud-android

stages.name: workstation-input-acknowledgement

stages.name: physical-android-rdc-input-acknowledgement
stages.doorway: physical Android independently controls Cloud Android through the same contract

stages.name: reconnect
stages.doorway: reconnect no longer destroys the device session

stages.doorway: Cloud Android is a persistent controllable device

stages.name: simultaneous-control-arbitration
stages.doorway: bidirectional screen control is operationally proven

stages.name: continuous-development
stages.doorway: the next implementation boundary is generated
